summary.title: CIS Benchmarks
summary.one_liner: CIS Benchmarks are consensus-based, prescriptive secure-configuration recommendations for more than 25 vendor product families, and this page is a searchable index of them by platform.
keywords: how to harden servers against cyber threats
takeaways: CIS Benchmarks are prescriptive configuration recommendations covering more than 25 vendor product families.
The benchmarks are described as a consensus-based effort by cybersecurity experts globally.
The page lists benchmarks grouped by product (e.g., operating systems, cloud providers, Kubernetes, databases, network devices), each with a version number.
Build Kits are offered to configure systems in accordance with a CIS Benchmark.
Some benchmarks can be tailored using a CIS SecureSuite Membership, as noted on the page.
summary.summary: This is the CIS Benchmarks index page from the Center for Internet Security. It describes the benchmarks as prescriptive, consensus-based configuration recommendations for more than 25 vendor product families, and offers a download option and a "Learn More" introduction. The main body is a long alphabetical list of benchmarks (AI, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Linux distributions, Microsoft products, Cisco, Juniper, and more), each with a version number, plus a note that some can be tailored via CIS SecureSuite Membership. It also links to Build Kits and a large set of DISA STIG entries listed alongside the CIS benchmarks.
